name: Credible sustainability standard recognition

regulatory_anchors.regulation: FCA Policy Statement PS23/16: Sustainability Disclosure Requirements (SDR) and investment labels
regulatory_anchors.article: Chapter 4: Sustainability labels (paragraphs 4.23-4.27 — credibility of standards used for Sustainability Focus eligibility)

summary: Tests whether the sustainability standard claimed by the developer is one PB methodology v3.5 recognises as credible for data-centre assets under the FCA Sustainability Focus label. PS23/16 requires standards to be 'robust' but does not enumerate which standards qualify; PB methodology recognises EU Taxonomy Activity 8.1 (preferred), LEED Platinum (with Energy & Atmosphere prerequisites), and SBTi (partial — covers emissions trajectory but not full sustainability profile). Claimed standards outside this set fail until a methodology update extends the recognised list.
